first.rationale: Verify the prior evidence that shortening onboarding improved completion and time-to-value. With onboarding completion down 4% and activation down 6%, a guarded simplification experiment directly addresses both leading indicators and may improve sustainable qualified revenue more reliably than matching competitor pricing. Monitor qualified pipeline, product depth, retention proxies, and activation—not completion alone—to detect any loss in downstream value.

final.rationale: Run a standard, guarded onboarding-simplification experiment this week. The archived source confirms a shortened flow increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing the current completion and activation declines. Evaluate qualified revenue, activation, retention, and downstream product depth alongside completion to ensure the lift is sustainable and not merely superficial.
